title: Recover stalled royal-queue bridge and add watchdog

payload.goal: Recover and harden royal-queue synchronization so current status is accurate, completed/superseded jobs cannot reappear as waiting_human, and new COSHUMA tasks are ingested exactly once.
requirements: Confirm why status/latest.json and dashboard.json previously stopped advancing after 2026-08-24T08:07Z while newer todo files existed; note that by 2026-08-26T00:00Z GitHub bridge/dashboard heartbeats and status generation recovered temporarily.
Check watcher, GitHub bridge, dashboard process health and heartbeat persistence.
Safely restart only failed/stuck queue processes using existing project scripts/config; do not touch secrets.
Fetch/sync the royal-queue branch and ingest all new todo jobs exactly once by UUID.

Fix the source-of-truth/sync logic that re-created stale waiting_human records after they had been removed from royal-queue. The bug reproduced again in sync commit 47848af7d254fe7abc0db02f019704ee9b00106b on 2026-08-26T01:06Z: apply-apollo, apply-aweber, apply-kit, apply-pipedrive, apply-tidio and supervisor-transition-test-20260824 were present again despite terminal/superseded states. The automation cleanup removed them again in commits f1a2985653a7f44f13ca8df8a310ebfc2d671b1f, b1d3d13ca706ec23c852061f1eb42604c8f8b3cf, e76fec7f642d4da66848f6a70d782609f03e01c5, f8d7c026950b216a1243828a34562ed6319022ef, 8dd3aa8761f322ecb021e6eadff95fbd3a651480 and 4f59cb91e34dd8adb3ee31756407f1b019e97632. The durable fix must prefer terminal done/failed/superseded results over older waiting_human copies and must not resurrect them on the next sync.

New recurrence evidence: as of 2026-08-26T02:06Z, status/latest.json is still frozen at generated_at 2026-08-26T01:05:47Z and dashboard.json at 2026-08-26T01:06:14Z even though royal-queue received later authoritative state changes. GoHighLevel was accepted and moved to done in commits 43265b725b9623dd2213fa1526a90507f9d45e86 and 18afc63c94ec428bb266ecd7340ef75d958cb16f; Kinsta submission was confirmed and moved to done/pending-review in commits 60141528506c95a7712feaf7ea18159d87495236 and 6b3d5c8d8bb9bad3c38fbc0d7f45b138f3030027; Synthesia and Jotform blockers advanced from password creation to email verification in commits 86b024866a5a69444858058decf64d93a5a78909 and da712dbed830079a6712678d43ef5701acef7f5a. Regenerated status must reflect these newer authoritative states and stop reporting GoHighLevel/Kinsta as waiting_human.

Additional recurrence evidence at 2026-08-26T04:10Z: vidIQ received an official affiliate approval email with unique tracking URL https://vidiq.com/coshuma and was moved from waiting_human to done in commits cc8512213619fcc4cf8b2a51e70ab6aab1ec6414 and c854c171ec3d739575ab21eabbea779d2352fc92, while status/latest.json and dashboard.json still remained at the older 01:05Z/01:06Z snapshots. Recovered status generation must reflect apply-vidiq as done and must not recreate its obsolete activation blocker.

Additional recurrence evidence at 2026-08-26T06:41Z: Jotform sent an official 'Welcome to the Jotform Affiliate Program!' approval email and royal-queue authoritative result apply-jotform was updated to approved_active in commit b5bc2dd32af858732a0764f5df77cfb45e624d8a. status/latest.json still reports apply-jotform as waiting_human from 2026-08-26T01:00Z. Recovered status generation must resolve apply-jotform from the newer authoritative done result and must not recreate its obsolete verification blocker.

Additional reconciliation evidence at 2026-08-26T09:18Z: royal-queue HEAD advanced to cf79563603cc4936533b03878c7c61d0f0317cba, but status/latest.json remains generated_at 2026-08-26T01:05:47Z and dashboard.json remains generated_at 2026-08-26T01:06:14Z. The authoritative waiting_human directory currently contains only seven files: apply-clickfunnels, apply-cloudways, apply-elevenlabs, apply-heygen, apply-manychat, apply-omnisend, and apply-synthesia, while dashboard.json still reports waiting_human=19 and latest.json still contains obsolete GoHighLevel/Jotform/Kinsta/vidIQ and duplicate terminal entries. The repaired generator must reconcile counts and latest states from authoritative terminal/in_progress/waiting_human files and prove the stale 19-count does not recur after a subsequent sync cycle.

Additional recurrence evidence at 2026-08-26T13:16Z: status/latest.json and dashboard.json are still frozen at generated_at 2026-08-26T01:05:47Z / 01:06:14Z while royal-queue HEAD is already 167ccae78372e363d079dfa1912368614756d836 and new authoritative COSHUMA affiliate state continues to arrive; Descript was officially approved at 2026-08-26T13:13:09Z with personal referral URL https://get.descript.com/ole5fu20j5sq. The recovered status generator must advance beyond the frozen snapshot and must not infer current affiliate state from the stale latest/dashboard cache.

Fresh recurrence evidence at 2026-08-26T21:34Z: sync commits f632b1cdff2d5feaaee64cb667cdf62dbce64cec and 6eff79acdae3749b5458d65ad85be4c0eb79adb2 re-created waiting_human=23 after prior cleanups. Fifteen of those files were stale copies with authoritative done/failed/in_progress/superseded states: apply-10web, apply-apollo, apply-aweber, apply-chatbase, apply-gohighlevel, apply-jotform, apply-kinsta, apply-kit, apply-pipedrive, apply-semrush, apply-surfer-seo, apply-synthesia, apply-tidio, apply-vidiq, and supervisor-transition-test-20260824. Automation reconciled those stale copies again, leaving exactly eight true forced-human blockers: apply-clickfunnels, apply-cloudways, apply-elevenlabs, apply-fireflies-ai, apply-frase, apply-heygen, apply-manychat, and apply-omnisend. The durable repair must preserve this precedence across the next sync: failed/done/in_progress/superseded overrides stale waiting_human, while only genuine CAPTCHA/legal/payment/credential/OTP/forced-verification cases remain waiting_human.

Freshest recurrence evidence at 2026-08-27T00:19Z: status/latest.json is generating again (generated_at 2026-08-26T22:43:56Z) and dashboard.json is also current (generated_at 2026-08-26T22:44:24Z), but the semantic reconciliation bug remains. latest.json simultaneously lists apply-fireflies-ai/apply-frase/apply-surfer-seo/apply-jotform/apply-chatbase/apply-gohighlevel/apply-kinsta/apply-synthesia/apply-vidiq as done and also repeats several of them as waiting_human; dashboard.json reports waiting_human=23. The authoritative waiting_human directory contains only six files: apply-clickfunnels, apply-cloudways, apply-elevenlabs, apply-heygen, apply-manychat, apply-omnisend. The repaired generator must derive a single winning state per UUID and reconcile dashboard counts to the six authoritative forced-human blockers. Watcher is still offline, while GitHub bridge and dashboard remain alive.

Fresh reconciliation evidence at 2026-08-27T03:19Z: royal-queue authoritative todo tree contains only five UUID files, while dashboard.json still reports todo=118. UUID 62e114d0-a161-4a40-a768-c39b2d60d4fb is present simultaneously in todo and done; its done copy reports result.success=true but internal status=in_progress, proving directory name alone is not sufficient terminal-state evidence. The repair must select exactly one winning record per UUID using explicit status/result semantics plus freshness, remove stale directory duplicates without discarding genuinely unfinished work, and make dashboard todo/waiting_human counts match the authoritative deduplicated state.

New status-generator stall evidence at 2026-08-27T08:23Z: status/latest.json is frozen at generated_at 2026-08-26T22:43:56.615614Z and dashboard.json at 2026-08-26T22:44:24.020625Z, while the royal-queue branch advanced much later to HEAD 8f725d270164015a9becfad617bae50c9cf20502 at 2026-08-27T07:17:14Z. Current authoritative directory counts are todo=4, in_progress=1, waiting_human=6, but the frozen dashboard still reports todo=115, in_progress=8, waiting_human=23. This proves status generation/heartbeat publication stalled again after about 07:44 KST while branch writes continued; the dashboard's embedded bridge/dashboard 'alive' heartbeats are stale snapshot data, not current liveness evidence. Recovery must restore periodic status generation and heartbeat persistence, then prove the fix with a subsequent branch change followed by fresh latest/dashboard generated_at timestamps and counts matching the contemporaneous deduplicated authoritative state, without resurrecting stale waiting_human records.

Treat waiting_reply/escalated vendor-support states such as apply-semrush separately from true forced-human states; they must not count as waiting_human unless an actual CAPTCHA, legal acceptance, payment approval, credential/OTP step, or other forced human verification is currently required.
Reconcile waiting_human counts against actual directory contents after every sync; status/latest.json and dashboard.json must not report stale duplicates.

Verify the COSHUMA tasks 62e114d0-a161-4a40-a768-c39b2d60d4fb, 24bb2f8d-36c5-4d53-9a46-234220e66019, aeb54240-1142-41e0-af3a-96e617b5bc2a, e04621f3-c462-4963-bf23-7e5e69248876 and Work task 8c8a6f94-5db6-4c38-bb0f-7d77a9c0d72f are not duplicated and become eligible for normal routing.
Add or repair a zero-cost watchdog so stale heartbeat or dead bridge/watcher is automatically detected and safely restarted or surfaced as failed, without spawning duplicate workers.

Update dashboard/latest status after recovery and return root cause, actions taken, tests, exact resulting statuses, and a reconciliation test proving stale waiting_human records stay absent across at least one subsequent sync cycle.
No payments, no production deploy, no account changes, no CAPTCHA handling, no secrets access.
